items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And then when the great singers come along in the age later on, like Bessie Smith, Ethel Waters, and all of them, they sang blues.

ctx.x: It's just the blues. And then when the great singers come along in the age later on, like Bessie Smith, Ethel Waters, and all of them, they sang blues.
When did you first hear -- had you heard blues at this point in Philadelphia?
